description: Holds six scenes of five signals each and crossfades between them, stepping from scene to scene on a clock

params.text: Switched on, the sequence returns to the first scene once the last one has run its steps; switched off it stops there and the outputs fade to silence
Sets how long the crossfade from one scene to the next takes, 0 to 20 seconds; at 0 the change is instant
Returns to the first scene and zeroes the step counts for as long as the button is held
Sets how many of the six scenes the sequence uses, 1 to 6
Sets where in the current scene its own alert output fires, as a fraction from 0 to 1 of that scene's step count
Sets how many clock pulses its own scene lasts, 1 to 16

inputs.text: A rising edge advances the step count by one
A rising edge returns to the first scene and zeroes the step counts
Feeds its own column's output while its own row is the scene being played, and is crossfaded against the scene being left

outputs.text: Sends a 1ms pulse at 10V when the current scene reaches the step its own knob points at
Carries whichever signal input of its own column belongs to the scene being played, crossfaded from the one that belonged to the scene before

notes: nothing advances until a clock reaches the trigger jack; the module starts on the first scene
the crossfade runs from the scene being left to the scene arriving, so both scenes' inputs reach the outputs while it runs
with the loop switch off the outputs fall to silence once the last scene's steps have run, and only a reset brings them back
an alert knob at 0 fires its output once when the patch is started and then never again, because the step count inside a scene begins at 1

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
